Tracks vote signatures with a deque and hash map for insert and query.

# Purpose
This file implements `fd_vote_tracker`, a fixed-size data structure for tracking vote signatures. It combines a deque and a hash map to keep the most recent `VOTE_TRACKER_MAX` signatures and to support fast lookup by `fd_signature_t`. The deque stores entries in insertion order, and the map stores the same entries by key so the code can remove the oldest entry when the deque is full and can test whether a signature is already present.

The file defines the internal layout of `fd_vote_tracker_t`, plus the memory size and alignment helpers [`fd_vote_tracker_align`](<#fd_vote_tracker_align>) and [`fd_vote_tracker_footprint`](<#fd_vote_tracker_footprint>). It also defines the constructor [`fd_vote_tracker_new`](<#fd_vote_tracker_new>), the attach function [`fd_vote_tracker_join`](<#fd_vote_tracker_join>), the insert function [`fd_vote_tracker_insert`](<#fd_vote_tracker_insert>), and the query function [`fd_vote_tracker_query_sig`](<#fd_vote_tracker_query_sig>). The deque and map types are built from template source files, and the public API uses offsets inside one memory block to access both internal containers.
